compliance.status: no challenge filed (numbers established by default March 1, 2025)

notes: DCA calculated present need=0 and prospective need=329, which the Borough accepted in its binding resolution January 28, 2025. No interested party challenged by February 28, 2025 deadline; numbers established by default March 1, 2025. Fourth Round VLA gives RDP=10 from Cioffi Site (Block 201 Lots 10-14 and Block 205 Lots 1,2,4 — 20-32 Sylvan Ave and 4 Bayview Ave, 1.985 acres). Cioffi Site: 48-unit mixed-use inclusionary, 10 affordable family rental units (20% set-aside), 2.5 rental bonus credits. Unmet Need=316.5 (329 - 12.5 credits). Unmet need addressed via: (1) Southern Sylvan Avenue Overlay Zone C (Block 617 Lots 6, 13-17; 11-14 aff units), (2) Southern Sylvan Avenue Overlay Zone D (Block 130 Lots 22-25, Block 313 Lots 1-3, Block 314 Lots 10-15, Block 411 Lots 16-23; 166-199 aff units), (3) amended MSO (60 units), (4) 79.5 remaining bonus credits. Third Round (combined 584-unit new construction obligation) addressed via 100% affordable Hudson Terrace/Cliffs on Hudson (Block 513/514; 65 aff units, under construction), New LG/North Woods inclusionary (Block 207 Lot 6; 12 aff units), 800 Sylvan Avenue (Block 910 Lot 1; 90 aff units, under construction), and multiple overlay zones for unmet need. Rehab obligation is 0.

sources.title: Borough of Englewood Cliffs Housing Element and Fair Share Housing Plan (June 2025)
sources.excerpt: The Borough's Fourth Round prospective need obligation of 329 units subtracted by the 12.5 credits used to satisfy the Borough's Fourth Round RDP results in a Fourth Round unmet need obligation of 316.5 units.

sites.site_name: Cioffi Site (20-32 Sylvan Avenue / 4 Bayview Avenue)
sites.proposed_zoning: Downtown Tiers (Hudson Terrace, East Palisades and B-3 Zone) Inclusionary Housing Overlay -2 (IHO-2)
sites.adoption_status: proposed; developer CFI Development LLC has expressed commitment
sites.quote: 10 units from the Cioffi Site (20-32 Sylvan Avenue and 4 Bayview Avenue; Block 201, Lots 10-14, Block 205, Lots 1,2, & 4). The proposal is for a three-story inclusionary mixed-use development consisting of 9,494 square feet of commercial space on the ground floor and forty-eight (48) apartments on the upper two floors. The residential portion of the development includes a twenty percent (20%) set aside that will create ten (10) affordable family rental units.
sites.notes: Fourth Round RDP site. 8 individual lots totaling 1.985 acres. Candidate had Block 201 Lots 10-14 — confirmed; also includes Block 205 Lots 1,2,4. Key clarification.

sites.site_name: Hudson Terrace / Michaels Development / 'Cliffs on Hudson' (100% Affordable)
sites.address: 474 & 482 Hudson Terrace and 4 Clendinen Place / 488 Hudson Terrace
sites.adoption_status: site plan approved August 8, 2024; under construction
sites.quote: Borough-owned Block 513, Lot 7, Block 514, Lots 4 & 5 (approximately 1.4-acres owned by the Borough), and an approximately 0.24-acre, 190 feet long portion of Clendinen Place to-be-vacated… Block 513, Lot 5 at 488 Hudson Terrace… On August 8, 2024, the Planning Board granted amended preliminary and final site plan approval for the 'Cliffs on Hudson' project, which will provide 65 affordable family rental units (14 very-low, 19 low, 32 moderate).
sites.notes: Third Round RDP site. Under construction. 46 rental bonus credits applied toward Third Round RDP. Candidate had 'Southern Sylvan Blocks 130/314/411' — these are different sites (unmet need overlay zones); Hudson Terrace/Cliffs on Hudson is the 100% affordable site.

sites.site_name: New LG / North Woods (111 Sylvan Avenue)
sites.mechanism: inclusionary overlay (IH-1 Zone; portion of site)
sites.quote: 12 affordable units from the New LG/North Woods site (Portion of Block 207 Lot 6 located at 111 Sylvan Avenue). A development of up to sixty (60) total family units with a 20% affordable housing set-aside, yielding 12 affordable non-age-restricted housing units, shall be permitted on a +/- 3.5-acre portion of the 'New LG site' (Block 207, Lot 6).
sites.notes: Third Round RDP site. 3.5-acre portion of larger Block 207 Lot 6 parcel. Rezoned IH-1 via Ordinance 20-13.

sites.quote: 90 affordable family rental units from 800 Sylvan Avenue (Block 910, Lot 1). On July 15, 2022, the Appellate Division of the Superior Court of New Jersey upheld the Settlement Agreement for the provision of 450 residential units, inclusive of 90 affordable family rental units, at 800 Sylvan Avenue. The 800 Sylvan Avenue site has secured approvals and is currently under construction.
sites.notes: Third Round RDP site. Under construction. Appellate Division affirmed July 15, 2022. 28.78-acre site. Candidate had 800 Sylvan Ave — confirmed as Block 910 Lot 1.
